turn.question: I have one deficient course and want to start FYP-I. Does the exception mean approval is automatic?
turn.answer:
Having one deficient course does not make approval to start FYP-I automatic [S1]. Under the exception policy, the Head of Department can allow registration in FYP-I where there is a deficiency of one course [S1].

**Related conditions and exceptions from the retrieved sources:**

> A stud ent shall re gister for FYP-I in h is/her second last semester. The Head of Department will approve registration in FYP-I based on the student’s ability to graduate in the subsequent semester. [S1]

diagnostics.history_context:
Student: My CGPA increased from 1.98 to exactly 2.00 after my first warning. Does the warning remain because I did not exceed 2.00?
Assistant (context only): If the CGPA equals or exceeds 2.00 after the 1 st or 2nd academic warning, the warning count is reset to zero.  This establishes a reset of the warning count, not deletion of historical warnings from university records.

Student: My attendance is 79%, but I passed every quiz. Can my quiz performance make me eligible for the final?
Assistant (context only): Passing every quiz does not make you eligible for the final examination if you fail to meet the attendance requirements . Students are required to maintain 100% attendance in lectures, labs, tutorials, seminars, and discussions as prescribed by the course instructor, though an absence of a maximum of 20% of the total attendance may be condoned by the HoD for genuine reasons such as illness . Failure to meet these attendance requirements in a course renders the student ineligible to appear in the final examination of the concerned course and results in an F/A grade being assigned .

Student: My instructor verbally agreed to move our class. Is that alone the documented rescheduling procedure?
Assistant (context only): A verbal agreement by the instructor is not the documented rescheduling procedure for FAST CFD undergraduate courses . 

In case of any unavoidable situation, classes may only be postponed and rescheduled according to the following rules:
* All classes are rescheduled solely through the Academic Office with the approval of the concerned Head of Department (HoD) .
* Faculty members are strictly prohibited from rescheduling any class at their own discretion .
* The academic office must be informed before the cancellation of the class so that students can be notified well in time .

Student: I passed theory and failed lab. My friend failed theory and passed lab. Explain what each of us must repeat.
Assistant (context only): If a student passes Theory but fails in Lab, only Lab needs to be repeated. In this c ase if a student also r egisters for Theory, s/he may withdraw from Theory later and continue with the lab. 

If a student fails in Theory but passes the Lab, both theory and lab must be repeated. 

Student: I passed both theory and lab but want to improve the course grade. Can I repeat only theory?
Assistant (context only): A student who has passed both Theory and Lab and wishes to improve their grade in the course must register for both Theory and Lab, and Rule 4.6 (which states that a student cannot withdraw from either the Theory or Lab part of the course and must withdraw from both) will apply . Therefore, you cannot repeat only the theory part .

Student: I am on my second warning, and a new course is available. Does availability alone let me register?
Assistant (context only): New-course registration is conditional, not automatic:

> Students on 2 nd academic warning must NOT register for a new course, unl ess recommended by the HoD and approved by Controller of Examinations.

VI – SEMESTER RULES 
1. Dates/week of sessional exams and the final exam are 
announced at the commencement of the semester. 
Students are not allowed to miss any of the sessional 
and/or the final exams. No credit for the missed exams 
would be given to the student. 
2. Students are allowed to apply online for the retake of any 
missed exam due to hospitalization, accident, or family 
emergencies such as the death or marriage of a blood 
relative. They must provide valid proof for any of these 
reasons. Please note that a mere medical certificate will 
not be accepted for this facility. 
3. Students are strongly advised to avoid scheduling any 
personal events during the examination period. However, 
in case of a clash with an event, the co mmittee may 
review the request based on submitted evidence and 
decide accordingly. 
4. Please note that clashes due to Umrah or Itikaf will not be 
considered, as these are not mandatory requirements. 
5. In all cases, the Director is the final authority who would,  
after consultation with the concerned faculty member (s), 
give a decision within one week from the date of 
submission of the application. 
6. Students are allowed to Add/Drop a course during the 
first two weeks of the commencement of the semester. 
However, students admitted in First semester shall not be 
allowed to Add/Drop a course. Students are advised to 
attend all the classes of courses they intend to take 
during the semester. No add/drop requests will be 
entertained after the last date.
